Registration yields a Unique Entity ID (UEI) and a public entity record searchable at sam.gov/search (public display can be opted out of, so keep it public for citation value). Official guidance repeatedly warns that registration is free and third parties charging for it are resellers.
payment: none - SAM.gov and its Quick Start Guides state there is no cost to register or maintain an entity registration
link_attribute: none (entity record carries corporate data incl. optional entity URL as text, not an SEO link)
relevance: low-medium - worthwhile only if pursuing US federal/institutional procurement (research reagents to US government labs is plausible); otherwise a pure identity/trust record from a .gov registry
approval_required: yes (entity validation / documentation review, can take weeks for foreign entities)
seo_value: minimal (no link), moderate trust/verification signal (UEI + .gov public record)
risk: none (official US government system); avoid paid 'SAM registration help' resellers
